two_tier_strategy.tier_1: Advancement: Senior Manager/Director target lanes, usually $180K-$250K+ base, strong strategic direction and long-term trajectory.
two_tier_strategy.tier_2: Lateral exit/scope broadening: Chicago/close-suburb/remote roles that can at least meet current ~$120K base, have high transferable fit, and broaden enterprise scope, brand, systems or analytics exposure. Hidden gates still apply; salary alone does not make a safety role.
